sections.title: Complete Liturgy and Anaphora of St. Gregory
sections.title_am: ሙሉ ሥርዓተ ቅዳሴና የቅዱስ ጎርጎርዮስ ቅዳሴ

verses.text_geez: አርኅዉ ኆኃተ መኳንንት፡፡
verses.text_am: እናንት መኳንንት ደጆቻችሁን ክፈቱ፡፡
verses.text_en: Lift up your gates, O ye Princes.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: መኑ ውእቱ ዝንቱ ንጉሠ ስብሐት ፤ መኑ ውእቱ ዝንቱ ንጉሠ ስብሐት ፤መኑ ውእቱ ዝንቱ ንጉሠ ስብሐት ፡፡
verses.text_am: ይኽ የክብር ንጉሥ ማነው፡ ይኽ የክብር ንጉሥ ማነው፡ ይኽ የክብር ንጉሥ ማነው፡
verses.text_en: Who is this King of glory? Who is this King of glory? Who is this King of glory?
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር አምላከ ኃያላን ፤ ውእቱ ዝንቱ ንጉሠ ስብሐት ፤ አርኅው ኆኃተ መኳንንት፡፡
verses.text_am: ይኽ የክብር ንጉሥ የኃያላን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነው፡፡ ብርቱና ኃያል እግዚአብሔር ነው፡፡ እናንት መኳንንት ደጆቻችሁን ክፈቱ፡፡
verses.text_en: Verily, the King of Glory is the Lord God Almighty, strong and mighty. Lift up your gates, O ye Princes.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ይባዕ ንጉሠ ስብሐት አምላከ ምሕረት
verses.text_am: የክብር ንጉሥ ይግባ ፤ የምሕረት አምላክ ይግባ፡፡
verses.text_en: Open your gates, and let the King of Glory enter in; let in and receive the merciful God with reverence.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ይህች ቀን ምን ያህል የምታስፈራ ናት ፤ ይህችስ ሰዓት ምን ያህል የምታስጨንቅ ናት ፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ከሰማየ ሰማያት የሚወርድባት፤
verses.text_en: How awesome is this day and how marvelous this hour wherein the Holy Spirit will descend from heaven
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ይህን መሥዋዕቱን የሚሰውርባትና የሚያከብርባት። በጽሞናና በመፍራት ቁሙ ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ሰላም ከእኔና ከእናንተ ጋራ ይሆን ዘንድ ጸልዩ ።
verses.text_en: and overshadow and hallow this sacrifice. In quietness and in fear, arise and pray that the peace of God be with me and with all of you.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሜን
verses.text_en: Amen
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ኩሉ ዘገብራ ለጽድቅ ጻድቅ ውእቱ ወዘያከብር ሰንበተ ኢይበል ፈላሲ ዘገብአ ኀበ እግዚአብሔር ይፈልጠኒኑ እምሕዝቡ ኩሉ ዘገብራ ለጽድቅ፥ ጻድቅ ውእቱ ወዘያከብር ሰንበተ
verses.text_am: በጎን የሚያደርግ ሰንበትንም የሚያከብር ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው። ወደ አግዚአብሔር አምልኮ የገባ መጻተኛ ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይለየኝ ይሆን: አይበል በጎ ያደረገ ሰንበትንም የሚያከብር ጻድቅ ነው።
verses.text_en: Blessed is he who does blessed deeds and honors the Sabbath. Let him not question whether he will be outcast from the multitudes if he was to enter into the worship of God. Blessed is he who does blessed deeds and honors the Sabbath.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ሃሌ ሉያ! እመቦ ብእሲ እምእመናን ዘቦአ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በጊዜ ቅዳሴ ወኢሰምአ መጻሕፍተ ቅዱሳተ ወኢተዐገሰ እስከ ይፌጽሙ ጸሎተ ቅዳሴ....
verses.text_am: ሃሌ ሉያ በቅዳሴ ጊዜ ከምእመናን ወገን ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን የገባ ሰው ቢኖር ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍትን ሰምቶ የቅዳሴውን ጸሎት እስኪጨርሱ ባይታገስ ከቁርባን ባይቀበል ከቤተ ክርስቲያን ይውጣ
verses.text_en: Halleluia! If there be anyone of the faithful that hath entered the church at the time of mass and hath not heard the holy Scriptures, and hath not waited until they finish the prayer of the Mass, and hath not received the holy communion, let him be driven out of the church:
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ወኢተመጠወ እምቀርባን ይሰደድ እምቤተ ክርስተያን እሰመ አማሰነ ሕገ እግዚአብሔር ወአስተሐቀረ ቁመተ ቅድመ ንጉሥ ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ ሥጋ ወመንፈስ ከመዝ መሐሩነ ሐዋርያት በአብጥሊሶሙ።
verses.text_am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ አፍርሷልና የነፍስና የሥጋ ንጉስ በሚሆን በሰማያዊ ንጉሥ በክርስቶስ ፊት መቆምን አቃሏልና ሐዋርያት በሲኖዶሳቸው እንዲህ ሲሉ አሰተማሩን
verses.text_en: for he hath violated the law of God and disdained to stand before the heavenly King, the King of Body and Spirit. This the Apostles have taught us in their canons.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: አንቲ ውእቱ መሶበ ወርቅ ንጹሕ እንተ ውስቴታ መና ኅቡእ ኅብስት ዘወረደ እምሰማያት ወሃቤ ሕይወት ለኩሉ ዓለም
verses.text_am: ንጹሕ የወርቅ መሶብ አንቺ ነሸ፤ በውስጧ የተሰወረ መና የነበረባት፤ ከሰማያት የወረደ ኅብስት ለዓለም ሁሉ ድኅነት የሚሰጥ
verses.text_en: Thou art the pot of pure gold wherein is hidden the manna, the bread which came down from heaven giving life unto all the world.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ንጹሕ ወጣዕም ወበረከት ለእለ ይሰትዩ እምደምከ ክቡር አላትዬን በአማን አሜን።
verses.text_am: በእውነት ሰው የሆንህ አምላክ ሆይ ንጹሕ ጣዕም በረከትም ከክቡር ደምህ ለሚጠጡ ይሁን፤ አሜን
verses.text_en: Purity, sweetness and blessing be to them who honestly drink of Thy precious blood. Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ቡሩክ እግዚአብሔር አብ አኃዜ ኩሉ ዓለም አምላክነ - አሜን።
verses.text_am: ዓለሙን ሁሉ የያዘ እግዚአብሔር አብ ቡሩክ ነው - አሜን።
verses.text_en: Blessed be the Lord, almighty Father, our God – Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ወቡሩክ ወልድ ዋሕድ እግዚእነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መድኃኒነ - አሜን።
verses.text_am: ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወልድ ዋሕድም ቡሩክ ነው- አሜን።
verses.text_en: And blessed be the only Son, our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ - Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ወቡሩክ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ጳራቅሊጦስ መጽንዒ ወመንጽሔ ኩልነ - አሜን።
verses.text_am: ሁላችንን የሚያነጻ፣ የሚያጸና መንፈስ ቅዱስም ቡሩክ ነው - አሜን።
verses.text_en: And blessed be the Holy Spirit, the Paraclete, the comforter and cleanser of us all - Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ስብሐት ወክብር ይደሉ ለሥሉስ ቅዱስ አብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ዕሩይ ኩሎ ጊዜ ይእዜኒ ወዘልፈኒ ወለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን።
verses.text_am: ልዩ ሦስት ለሚሆኑ ሁልጊዜም ለተካከሉ ለአብ ለወልድ ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ ክብር ምስጋና ይገባል ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: Glory and honour are due to the holy Trinity, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, always coequal, both now and ever and unto the ages of ages. Amen
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ጸልዩ አበውየ ወአኅውየ ላዕሌየ ወላዕለ ዝንቱ መሥዋዕት።
verses.text_am: አባቶቼና ወንድሞቼ በእኔ ላይ መሥዋዕቱም ላይ ጸልዩ።
verses.text_en: My fathers and my brothers, pray for me and for this sacrifice.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ይስማዕከ ኩሎ ዘሰአልከ ወይትወከፍ መሥዋዕተከ ወተርባነከ ከመ መሥዋዕተ መለከጴዴቅ ወአሮን ወዘካርያስ ካህናተ ቤተ ክርስቲያኑ ለበኩር።
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር የለመንከውን ሁሉ ይስማህ። የቤተ ክርስቲያኑ ካህናቱ የሚሆኑ የመልከ ጴዴቅንና የአሮንን የዘካርያስንም መሥዋዕት እንደ ተቀበለ መሥዋዕትህን ተርባንህንም ይቀበልልህ። ሁሉም አቡነ ዘበሰማያት ይበሉ።
verses.text_en: May God hear you in all that you have asked and accept your sacrifice and offering like the sacrifice of Melchisedec and Aaron and Zacharias, the priests of the church of the firstborn. Our Father ……
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ተዘከረኒ ኦ አቡየ ቀሲስ በጸሎትከ ቅድስት።
verses.text_am: አባቴ ሆይ ክብርት በምትሆን በጸሎትህ አስበኝቸ
verses.text_en: Remember me, my father priest, in your holy prayers.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ይዕቀባ ለክህነትከ ወይትወከፍ መሥዋዕተከ ወተርባነከ በብሩህ ገጽ። ሥመር እግዚኦ ከመ ታድኅነኒ።
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ክህነትህን ይጠብቃት፤ መሥዋዕትህንና ተርባንህንም በብሩህ ገጽ ይቀበልልህ፤ አቤቱ እኔን ታድነኝ ዘንድ ማዳንን ውደድ።
verses.text_en: The Lord keep your priesthood and accept your sacrifice and offering with a gracious countenance. Be pleased, Lord, to save me.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ካሀን አሐዱ አብ ቅዱስ አሐዱ ወልድ ቅዱስ አሐዱ ውእቱ መንፈስ ቅዱስ።
verses.text_am: አንዱ አብ ቅዱስ ነው፤ አንዱ ወልድ ቅዱስ ነው፤ አንዱ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ቅዱስ ነው።
verses.text_en: One is the Holy Father, one is the Holy Son, one is the Holy Spirit.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: በአማን አብ ቅዱስ በአማን ወልድ ቅዱስ በአማን ውእቱ መንፈስ ቅዱስ።
verses.text_am: አብ በእውነት ቅዱስ ነው፤ ወልድ እውነት ቅዱስ ነው፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስ በእውነት ቅዱስ ነው።
verses.text_en: Truly the Father is holy, truly the Son is holy, truly the Holy Spirit is holy.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ሰብሕዎ ለእግዚአብሔር ኩልክሙ አሕዛብ ምእመናን ሁላችሁም እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት
verses.text_en: Praise the Lord, all ye nations.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ወይሴብሕዎ ኩሎሙ ሕዝብ ሕዝብም ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል
verses.text_en: And praise Him, all ye people.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እስመ ጸንዐት ምሕረቱ ላዕሌነ ምሕረቱ በእኛ ላይ ጸንታለችና
verses.text_en: For His merciful kindness is great toward us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ጽድተሰ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሄሉ ለዓለም የእግዚአብሔርስ ቸርነቱ ለዘለዓለሙ ይኖራል።
verses.text_en: And the Truth of the Lord endured forever.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: (ካህኑን በመከተል ሕዝቡ ይህንን ይድገሙ)
verses.text_am: ስብሐት ለአብ ፣ ወወልድ ፣ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ለአብና ለወልድ ለመንፈስ ቅዱስም ምስጋና ይገባል
verses.text_en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ይእዜኒ ወዘልፈኒ ወለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን ሃሌ ሉያ።
verses.text_am: ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘለዓለሙ አሜን ሃሌ ሉያ።
verses.text_en: Both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ጸሎተ አኩቴት ዘቅዱስ ባስልዮስ
verses.text_am: የቅዱስ ባስልዮስ የምስጋና ጸሎት
verses.text_en: The "Prayer of Thanksgiving" of St. Basil.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ነአኩቶ ለገባሬ ሠናያት ላዕሌነ እግዚአብሔር መሐሪ አቡሁ ለእግዚእነ ወአምላክነ ወመድኃኒነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ።
verses.text_am: ለእኛ በጎ ነገርን ያደረገ ይቅር ባይ እግዚአብሔርን እናመሰግነዋለን። ይቅር ባይ የጌታችን የአምላካችንና
verses.text_en: We give thanks unto the doer of good things unto us, the merciful God, the Father of our Lord and our God and our Savior Jesus Christ: for He hath covered
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እስመ ሰወረነ ወረድአነ ዐቀበነ ወአቅረበነ ወተወክፈነ ኅቤሁ። ወተማኅፀነነ። ወአጽንዐነ። ወአብጽሐነ እስከ ዛቲ ሰዓት።
verses.text_am: የመድኃኒታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አባት ሰውሮናልና ረድቶናልና ጠብቆ አቅርቦናልና ወደ እርሱም ተቀብሎናልና አጽንቶ ጠብቆናልና እስከዚች ሰዓት አድርሶናልና።
verses.text_en: us and succored us, He hath kept us and brought us nigh and received us unto Himself, and undertaken our defense, and strengthened us, and brought us unto this hour.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ንስአሎ እንከ ከመ ይዕቀበነ በዛቲ ዕለት ቅድስት ኩሎ መዋዕለ ሕይወትነ ወበኩሉ ሰላም አኃዜ ኩሉ እግዚአብሔር አምላክነ።
verses.text_am: አሁንም ክብርት በምትሆን በዚች ዕለት በሕይወታችን ዘመን ሁሉ በፍጹም ሰላም ሁሉን የሚይዝ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀን ዘንድ እንለምነው። ጸልዩ
verses.text_en: Let us therefore pray unto Him that the Almighty Lord our God keep us in this holy day and all the days of our life in all peace. ዲያቆን/Deacon Pray ye.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ሁሉን የያዝህ ጌታችን እግዚአብሔር የጌታችንና የአምላካችን የመድኃኒታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አባት በሥራው ሁሉ ላይ ስለ ሥራው ሁሉ በሥራውም ሁሉ ውስጥ እናመሰግንሃለን ስውረኸናልና ረድተኸናልና ጠብቀኸናልና ወዳንተ አቅርበህ ጠብቀኸናልና አጽንተህ ጠብቀኸናልና እስከዚችም ሰዓት አድርሰኸናልና።
verses.text_en: Master, Lord God Almighty, the Father of our Lord and our God and our Savior Jesus Christ, we render Thee thanks upon everything, for everything and in everything, for Thou hast covered us and succored us, hast kept us and brought us nigh, and received us unto Thyself, and undertaken our defense, and strengthened us and brought us unto this hour
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ኅሱ ወአስተብቀ፡ ከመ ይምሐረነ እግዚአብሔር ወይሣሃል ላዕሌነ
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ይምረን ዘንድ በእኛም ላይ ይቅር ይል ዘንድ እሹ ለምኑ።
verses.text_en: Entreat ye and beseech that the Lord have pity upon us and be merciful to us
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ወይትወከፍ ጸሎተ ወስእለተ እምነ ቅዱሳኒሁ በአንቲአነ በዘይሤኒ ኩሎ ጊዜ ይረስየነ ድልዋነ ከመንንሣእ እምሱታፌ ምሥጢር ቡሩክ ወይሥረይ ለነ ኃጣውኢነ።
verses.text_am: ስለኛ ከቅዱሳን ጸሎትን ልመናንም ይቀበል ዘንድ፤ ሁልጊዜ ማረ ነገር ቡሩክ ከሚሆን ምሥጢር አንድነት እንድንቀበል የበቃን ያደርገን ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: receive our prayer and supplication from His saints on our behalf, according to what is expedient at all times, so that He may make us ready to partake of the communion of the blessed sacra-ment and forgive us our sins.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ኪርየላይሶን
verses.text_en: Kyrie eleison.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ስለዚህ እንለምንሃለን ከቸርነትህም እንቫለን ሰውን የምትወድ ሆይ! ክብርት የምትሆን ይህችን እለት እን ድንፈጽም ስጠን፤ የሕይወታችንን ዘመን ሁሉ በፍጹም ሰላም አንተን ከመፍራት ጋራ
verses.text_en: For this cause we pray and entreat of Thy goodness, O lover of man, grant us to complete this holy day and all the days of our life in all peace along with Thy fear.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቅንዓትን ሁሉ መከራውንም ሁሉ የሰይጣን ንም ሥራ ሁሉ የክፎች ሰዎችንም ምክር የጠላትንም መነሣት የተሰወረውንና የተገለጸውን።
verses.text_en: All envy, all trial, all the working of Satan, the counsel of evil, and all the uprisings of adversaries, secret and open.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አቤቱ ከእኔ አርቅ። ከሕዝብህም ሁሉ ያንተ ከሚሆን ከዚህም ቅዱስ ቦታ በጎውን ነገር ሁሉ ያማረውንና የሚሻለውን እዘዝልን፤ እባቡን ጊንጡንም የጠላትንም ኃይል ሁሉ እንረግጥ ዘንድ ሥልጣንን የሰጠኸን አንተ ነህና። ወደ መከራ አታግባን ከከፉ አድነን እንጂ።
verses.text_en: remove far from me, and from all Thy people, and from this Thy holy place All good things, that are expedient and excellent, com-mand Thou for us, for Thou art He Who has given us power to tread upon serpents and scorpions and upon all the power of the enemy.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አንድ ልጅህ ጌታችንና አምላካችን መድኃኒታችን ም ኢየሱስ ከርስቶስ ለሰው ፍቅር ብሎ ባደረገው ቸርነትና ይቅርታ። በርሱ ያለ ምስጋና ከብር ጽን ዕ ከእርሱ ጋር ላንተ ይገባል፤ ካንተ ጋራ ትከከል ማኅየዊ ከሚሆን ከመንፈስ ቅድስም ጋራ ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: Lead us lest we wander into temptation, but deliver us and rescue us from all evil in the grace and loving kindness, shown by the love -towards mankind of Thine only-begotten Son, our Lord, God, and Saviour Jesus Christ, through Whom to Thee with Him and with the Holy Spirit, the life-giver, Who is coequal with Thee are due glory, honour, and dominion, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: (የሐዋርያት የመባ ጸሎት) ዳግመኛም ሁሉን የሚይዝ የጌታችንንና የመድኃኒታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አባት እግዚአብሔርን እንማልዳለን። ከሁሉ በላይ በምትሆን በከበረች በአንዲት ቤተ ከርስቲያን መባ ስለሚያገቡ መሥዋዕቱን ቀደምያቱን
verses.text_en: "The prayer of Oblation" of the Apostles. And again let us beseech the Almighty Lord, the Father of the Lord our Savior Jesus Christ, on behalf of those who bring an oblation within the one holy universal church, a sacrifice, first-fruits, tithes, a thank offering,
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ካሥር አንዱን የመታሰቢያ ምስጋና ብዙውንና ጥቂቱን የተሰወረውንና የተገለጸውን ይሰጡ ዘንድ ሲወዱ የሚሰጡት ከሌላቸው ላይ ፈቃዳቸውን ተቀብሎ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን ይሰጥ ዘንድ ለሁሉ በረከትን የሚያድልበት ሥልጣን ገንዘቡ የሚሆን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር።
verses.text_en: a memorial, whether much or little, in secret or openly, and of those who wish to give and have not wherewith to give, that He accept their ready mind, that He vouchsafe to them the heavenly kingdom; power over all works of blessing belongs to the Lord our God.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ንፍቅ ዲያቆን
verses.text_am: ጸልዩ በእንተ እለ ያበውኡ መባአ መባ ስለሚያገቡ ሰዎች ጸልዩ
verses.text_en: Pray for them who bring an oblation.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ሕዝብ
verses.text_am: ተወከፍ መባኦሙ ለአኃው ወተወከፍ መባኦን ለአኃት ለነኒ ተወከፍ መባአነ ወቀርባነነ የወንድሞችን መባ ተቀበል የእኅቶቻንም መባ ተቀበል፤ የእኛንም መባችንንና ተርባናችንን ተቀበል።
verses.text_en: Accept the oblation of our brethren, accept the oblation of our sisters, and ours also accept, our oblation and our offering.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ሁሉን የምትገዛ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሆይ! አን ለምንሃለን እንማልድሃለንም ከሁሉ በላይ በምትሆን ባን ዲት ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ውስጥ መባ ስለሚያገቡ ሰዎች መሥዋዕቱን መጀመሪያውን ካሥር አንዱን የመታሰቢያ ምስጋናን ብዙውንና ጥቂቱን የተሰወረውንና የተገለጸውን ይሰጡም ዘንድ ሲወዱ የሚሰጡት
verses.text_en: Lord our God who art Almighty, we pray Thee and beseech Thee for them that bring an oblation within the one holy universal church, a sacrifice, first-fruits, tithes, a thank offering, a memorial, whether much or little, in secret or openly, and for those who wish to give
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ከሌላቸው ላይ ፈቃዳቸውን ተቀብለህ ለሁሉም የበረከትን ዋጋን ስጥ፤ እድል ፈንታ ትሆን ዘንድ። በአንድ ልጅህ በርሱ ያለ ክብር ጽንዕ ላንተ ይገባል፤ ከርሱ ጋር ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ጋራ ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ፤ አሜን።
verses.text_en: and have not where with to give. Thy acceptance of their ready mind grant Thou unto every one: let the recompense of blessing be a portion to all of them: through Thy only begotten Son, through whom to Thee with Him and with the Holy Spirit be glory and dominion, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: የኅብስት ጸሎት
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: መምህሬ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆይ ከቀዳማዊ አብ ጋራ አንድ የምትሆን ፣ ንጹሕ የሚሆን የአብ ቃል ፣ የማሕየዊ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ቃል ፣
verses.text_en: - ("The prayer of Oblation.") O my Master, Jesus Christ, co-eternal pure Word of the Father, and Word of the Holy Spirit, the life giver, Thou art the bread of life
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ከሰማያት የወረድህ የሕይወት ኅብስት አንተ ነህ ስለ ዓለሙ መዳን ነውር የሌለበት መስዋዕት እንድትሆን መናገርን አስቀደምህ። አሁንም ከበጎነትህ ቸርነት እንለምናለን
verses.text_en: which did come down from heaven, and foretell that Thou wouldest be the Lamb without Spot for the life of the world:
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እንማልዳለንም ሰው ወዳጅ ሆይ ያንተ በሚሆን በዚህ በመንፈሳዊ ታቦት ላይ ባኖርነው በዚህ ኅብስት ላይና በዚህ ጽዋ ላይ ፊትህን ግለፅ። ይህንን ኅብስት ባርከው፣ ይህንንም ጽዋ አክብረው ሁለቱንም አንጻቸው።
verses.text_en: We now pray and beseech of Thine excellent goodness, O lover of man, make Thy face to shine upon this bread, and upon this cup, which we have set upon this spiritual ark of Thine: Bless this bread, and hallow this cup, and cleanse them both.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ይህ ንጹሕ ሥጋህን ይሆን ዘንድ ለውጠው። በዚህ ጽዋ ውስጥ የተቀዳውም ወይን የከበረ ደምህን ይሁን፤ ለሁላችንም ያረገ ለነፍሳችንና ለሥጋችን ለልቡናችንም ፈውስ ይሆን ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: And change this bread to become. Thy pure body, and what is mingled in this cup to become Thy precious blood, let them be offered for us all for healing and for the salvation of our soul and our body and our spirit.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አምላካችን ክርስቶስ የሁላችን ንጉሥ አንተ ነህ። ከፍ ያለ ምስጋናንና ክብርን ስግደትንም ላንተ እንልካለን። ቸር ከሚሆን ከሰማያዊ አባትህ ጋራ ከአንተ ጋራ ከሚተካከል ከማሕየዊ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ጋራ ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ ፤ አሜን።
verses.text_en: Thou art the King of us all, Christ our God, and to Thee we send up high praise and glory and worship, with Thy good heavenly Father and the Holy Spirit, the life giver, who is co-equal with Thee, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ትእዛዘ አበዊነ ሐዋርያት ኢያንብር ብእሲ ውስተ ልቡ ቂመ ወበቀለ ወቅንዓተ ወጽልአ ላዕለ ቢጹ ወኢላዕለ መኑሂ።
verses.text_am: ይህ የአባቶቻችን የሐዋርያት ትእዛዝ ነው። ሰው በልቦናው ቂምንና በቀልን ቅንዓትንና ጠብን በባልን ጀራው ላይ በማንም ላይ ቢሆን አይያዝ።
verses.text_en: This is the order of our fathers the Apostles: Let none Keep in his heart malice or revenge or envy or hatred towards his neighbor, or towards any other body.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ስግዱ ለእግዚአብሔር በፍርሃት በፍርሃት ሁናችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ
verses.text_en: Worship the Lord with fear.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቅድሜከ እግዚኦ ንሰግድ ወንሴብሐከ አቤቱ በፊትህ እንሰግዳለን እናመሰግንሃለንም
verses.text_en: Before Thee, Lord, we worship, and Thee do we glorify.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አቤቱ ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወልድ ዋሕድ የእግዚአብሔር አብ ቃል ማሕየዊት መድኃኒትም በምትሆን በሕማምህ ከእኛ የኃጢአታችንን ሁሉ ማሰሪያ ያጠፋህ። ን ጹሓን አገልጋዮችህ ፊት እፍ ያልህባቸዉ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበሉ፤ ይቅር ላላችኋቸዉ ኃጢአታቸዉ ይቀርላቸዋል፤ ይቅርም ላላላችኋቸዉ ኃጢአታቸዉ አይቀርላቸዉም ያልካቸዉ
verses.text_en: ፍትሐ ዘወልድ - “The Absolution of the Son” Master, Lord Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son, the Word of God the Father, Who has broken off from us all the bonds of our sins through Thy life-giving and saving sufferings, Who breathed upon the face of Thy holy disciples and pure ministers saying to them : “Receive the Holy Spirit_ whatsoever of men’s sins you remit they are remitted unto them, and whatsoever sins you retain they are retained.”
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሁንም በክብርት ቤተ ክርስቲያንህ ሁልጊዜ የክህነትን ሥራ ለሚሰሩ ለንጹሓን አገልጋዮችህ አቤቱ አንተ ክህነትን ሰጠህ፤ በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ይቅር ይሉ ዘንድ። ያስሩ ዘንድ የበደልን ም ማሰሪያ ሁሉ ይፈቱ ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: Thou therefore, O Lord, has now granted the priesthood to Thy pure ministers who always do the priests’ office in Thy holy church that they may remit sin on earth, may bind and loosen all the bonds of iniquity.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሁንም አቤቱ ሰዉ ወዳጅ ሆይ፤ ዳግመኛ ከቸርነትህ እን ለምናለን እንቫለንም። ስለነዚህ ስለ ወዳጆችም ስለ ሴቶችም ባሮችህ፤ አባቶቼና ወንድሞቼ እኅቶቼም ደካማ ስለምሆን ስለ እኔም ስለ ባርያህ፤ በቅዱስ መሠዊያህም ፊት ራሳቸዉን ዝቅ ስለ አደረጉ ሰዎች የምሕረትህን ጎዳና ጥረግልን የኃጢአታችንን ማሰሪያም ሁሉ ፈጽመህ አጥፋልን
verses.text_en: Once again we pray and en-treat of Thy goodness, O lover of man, on behalf of these Thy servants and handmaids, my fathers and my brothers and my sisters, and also on my own behalf, on me thy feeble servant, and on behalf of them that bow their heads before Thy holy altar. Prepare for us the way of Thy mercy, break and sever all the bonds of our sins
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አቤቱ አንተን ብንበድል በማወቅ ወይም ባለማወቅ በተን ኮልም ቢሆን በልቡና ክፋትም ቢሆን በመሥራትም ቢሆን በመናገርም ቢሆን የሰዉን ድካሙን አንተ ታዉቃለህና። ቸር ሰዉ ወዳጅ ሆይ የፍጥረቱ ሁሉ ጌታ አቤቱ የኃጢአታችንን ሥርየት ስጠን፤ ባርከን፤ አክብረንም ነጻም አድርገን፤ አን ጻን የተፈታን ነጻም የወጣን አድርገን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ፍታቸዉ
verses.text_en: whether we have tres-passed against Thee, O Lord, wittingly or unwittingly, whether in deceit or in vileness of heart, whether in deed or in word or through limited understanding, for Thou knows the feebleness of man. O good lover of man and Lord of all creation, grant us, O Lord, forgiveness of our sins, bless us and purify us, set us free and absolve all Thy people
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ስምህን መፍራትንም የተመላን አድርገን። ቅዱስ ፈቃድህንም በመፍራት አጽናን። ቸር ሆይ ጌታችንና አምላካችን መድኃኒታችን አንተ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነህና። ምስጋናንና ክብርን ለአንተ እናቀርባለን። ሰማያዊ ከሚሆን ከቸር አባትህ ጋራ፤ ማሕየዊ ከሚሆን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ጋራ ትክክል የሚሆን ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: and fill us with the fear of Thy name, and confirm us in doing Thy will. O Good One, for Thou art our Lord, God, and Saviour Jesus Christ, to Thee we send glory and honour, with the good heavenly Father, and the life–giving Holy Spirit, Who is coequal with Thee, both now and ever and unto the ages of ages. Amen
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: በዚህች ቀን ያገለገሉህ ባሮችህ ቅሱና ዲያቆኑ ካህናቱም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እኔም ድኃዉ ባርያህ የተፈቱና ነጻ የወጡ የነጹ ይሁኑ። ልዩ ሦስት በሚሆን በአብ በወልድ በምንፈስ ቅዱስ አፍ ሐዋርያት በሰበሰቧት በቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን አፍ፤ በዓሥራ አምስቱ ነቢያት አፍ በዓሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት አፍ፤ ሥልጣን
verses.text_en: May thy servants who serve on this day, the priests, deacons and other clergy (+ over the clergy), and all Thy people (+ over the people), and I myself (+ over himself),be absolved and set free, cleansed out of the mouth of the Holy Trinity: the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and out of the mouth of the one holy apostolic church, and out of the mouths of the fifteen prophets, and out of the mouths of the twelve apostles,
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አገልጋዮች በሆኑ በሰባ ሁለቱ አርድዕት አፍ መለኮትን በተናገረ ወንጌላዊ ሐዋርያና አማእትም በሆነ በማርቆስ አፍ። ንጹሕ ክቡር አባት በሚሆን በጳጳሳቱ አለቃ በሳዊሮስና በቅዱስ ዲዮስቆሮስ በቅዱስ አትናቴዎስም በቅዱስ ዮሐንስ አፈወርቅና በቅዱስ ቄርሎስ በቅዱስ ጎርጎርዮስና በቅዱስ ባስልዮስ ቃል።
verses.text_en: and out of the mouths of the seventy-two disciples and ministers, and out of the mouth of the speaker of divinity, the evangelist Mark, the apostle and martyr: and out of the mouths of the Patriarchs St. Severus, St. Dioscorus, St. Athanasius, St. John Chrysostom, St. Cyril, and Saints Gregory and Basil :
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አርዮስን ለማዉገዝ በኒቅያ በተሰበሰቡ ሃይማናታቸዉ በቀና በሦስት መቶ ዐሥራ ስምንት ሊቃዉንትም ቃል። መቅዶንዮስን ለማዉገዝ በቁስጥንጥንያ በተሰበሰቡ በመቶ አምሳዉ ሊቃዉንትም ቃል ንስጥሮስን ለማዉገዝ በኤፌሶን በተሰበሰቡ በሁለት መቶ ሊቃዉንትም ቃል በክቡር የጳጳሳቱ አለቃ . . . . . .
verses.text_en: and out of the mouths of the 318 orthodox that assembled in Nicaea to condemn Arius, and out out the mouths of the 150 that assembled in Constantinople to condemn Mace-donius, and out of the mouths of the 200 that assembled in Ephesus to condemn Nestor, and out of the mouth of the honoured Patriarch Abba . . . . . .
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ንዑድ ክቡር በሚሆን በጳጳሳችን በአባ . . . . . ቃል ድኃ ምስኪን በምሆን በኔም በኃጥኡ ቃል የተፈቱ ነጻም የወጡ ይሁኑ። አምላክን በወለደች በሁለት ወገን ድንግል በሆነች ባዲሲቱ መሣሪያ በክብርት እመቤታችን በማርያም ቃል። የቅዱስ ስምህ ምስጋና ቡሩክ ፍጹም ነዉና፤ ልዩ ሦስት የምትሆን አብ ወልድ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሆይ፤ ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ፤ አሜን።
verses.text_en: and the blessed Archbishop Abba (___), and out of the mouth of me also the sinful, miserable, and poor: may they be absolved and set free, and out of the mouth of our Lady holy Mary, of twofold vir-ginity, Mother of God, the new loom. For Thy holy name is blessed and full of glory, O holy Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, both now and ever and unto endless ages. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ዲያቆኑ ሲጸልይ ሕዝቡ በመከተል በየምዕራፉ «አሜን ኪርየላይሶን አቤቱ ይቅር በለን» ይበል
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አንድ ስለምታደርግ ሥጋውና ደሙ እግዚአብሔር በይቅርታው አንድ ያደርገን ዘንድ ሰላምን እንማልዳለን።
verses.text_en: For the peace holy things we beseech, that God may grant us peace through His Mercy.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር የሱን ሃይማኖት በንጹሕ እንድንጠብቅ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ስለ ሃይማኖታችን እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እስከ ፍጻሜያችን ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በመንፈስ ቅዱስ አን ድነት ይጠብቀን ዘንድ ስለ አንድነታችን እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For our Faith we beseech, that God may grantus to keep the faith in purity. For our congregation we beseech, that God may keepus unto the end in the communion of the Holy Spirit.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: በመከራችን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር የትዕግሥትን ፍጻሜ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ስለ ነፍሳችን ትዕግሥት እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: ቅዱሳን ስለሚሆኑ ነቢያት ከሳቸው ጋራ እግዚአብሔር ይቁጥረን ዘንድ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For patience of soul we beseech, that God may vouchsafe us perfect patience in all our tribulation For the holy prophets we beseech, that God may number us with them.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እነሱ ደስ እንዳሰኙት ደስ ልናሰኘው እግዚአብሔር (ማገልገሉን) ይሰጠን ዘንድ እድል ፈንታቸውንም ያድለን ዘንድ አገልጋዮች ስለሚሆኑ ሐዋርያት እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ለኛ የሰማዕትነትን ሥራ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ቅዱሳን ስለሚሆኑ ሰማዕታት እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the ministering Apostles we beseech, that God may grant us to be well pleasing even as they were well pleasing, apportion unto us a lot with them. For the Holy martyrs we beseech, that God may grant us to perfect the same conversation.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: የቤተ ክርስቲያን አገልጋዮች እነሱ ናቸውና እግዚአብሔር እነሱን ለረጅም ወራት ይሰጠን ዘንድ ያለ ነውር በንጽሕና ሆነው በዕውቀት የሃይማኖትን ቃል ያቀኑ ዘንድ ስለ ርእሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቱ . . . . ብጹዕ ስለሚሆን ስለ ሊቀ ጳጳሳችንም አባ . . . እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For our Patriarch … and the blessed Archbishop … we beseech, that grant them length of days to be over us, that with understanding they may rightly speak the word of faith in purity without spot for that they are the defenders of the church.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: የክህነትን ሥልጣን ከእነሱ እግዚአብሔር እንዳያርቅ መትጋትን እሱን መፍራትንም እስከ ፍጻሜ ይሰጥልን ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበል ዘንድ ስለ ቀሳውስት እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the priests we beseech, that God may never take from them the spirit of priesthood, and may give them the grace of zeal and fear of Him unto the end and accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ፈጽመው ሊፋጠኑ መፋጠንን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ በቅድስናም ይቀርቡ ዘንድ ድካማቸውንና ፍቅራቸውንም ያስብ ዘንድ ስለ
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the deacons we beseech, that God may grant them to run a perfect course, and draw them high unto Him in holiness, and remember their labor and their love.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: የሃይማኖታቸውን ትጋት ሊፈጽሙ እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስለ ንፍቀ ዲያቆናት ስለ አንባቢዎችም ስለ መዘምራንም እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the assistant deacons and the anagnosts and the singers we beseech, that God grant them to perfect the diligence of their faith.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ልመናቸውን ይሰማቸው ዘንድ ይልቁንም የመንፈስ ቅዱስን ሀብት በልቡናቸው ያሳድርባቸው ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበል ዘንድ ስለ ባልቴቶች ረዳትም ስለሌላቸው እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the widows and the bereaved we beseech, that God may hear their prayers and vouchsafe them abundantly in their hearts the grace of the Holy Spirit and accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር የድንግልናቸውን ዋጋ (አክሊል) ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔርም ወንዶችም ሴቶች ልጆች ይሆኑት ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበል ዘንድ ስለ ደናግል እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the virgins we beseech, that God may grant them the crown of virginity, and that they may be unto God sons and daughters and that He may accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: በመታገሳቸው ዋጋቸውን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰጣቸው ስለሚታገሱ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: በንጽሕና ሆነው ይጠብቁ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሃይማናትን እንዲሰጣቸው ስለ ሕዝባውያንና ስለ መሃይምናን እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For those who suffer patiently we beseech, that God grant them to receive their rewards through patience. For the laity and faithful we beseech, that God may grant them complete faith which they may keep in purity.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: በጎውን ዕድል ኃጢአትን ለማስተስረይ ሁለተኛ መወለድ የሚገኝበትን ሕጽበት እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ በቅድስት ሥላሴም ማኅተም ያከብራቸው ያትማቸው ዘንድ ስለ ን፡ሰ ክርስቲያን እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the catechumens we beseech, that God may grant them a good portion and the washing of regeneration for the remission of sin, and seal them with the seal of the Holy Trinity.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: በዘመኑ ፍጹም ሰላምን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን ስለምትወድ ስለ አገራችን ኢትዮጵያ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: ዕውቀትን እሱን መፍራትንም እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስለ መኳንንትና ሥልጣን ስላላቸው እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For our country Ethiopia we beseech, that God may give her peace forever. For the rulers and those in authority we beseech, that God may grant them of His wisdom and His fear.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ስለዓለሙ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ማሰብን ያስቀድም ዘንድ ለእያንዳንዱም የሚያስፈልገውን ያማረውን የሚሻውንም ያስብ ዘንድ ስለ ዓለም ሁሉ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the whole world we beseech, that God should hasten His purpose and put into the mind of all and each to desire that which is good and expedient.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ ባለው ቀኝ መርቶ በፍቅርና በደኅንነት ወደ ማደሪያቸው ይመልሳቸው ዘንድ በባሕርና በደረቅ ስለሚሄዱ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For them that travel by sea and by land we beseech, that God should guide them with a merciful right hand and let them enter their home in safety and peace.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር የዕለት የዕለት ምግባቸውን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስለተራቡና ስለተጠሙ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ፈጽሞ ያረጋጋቸው ዘንድ ስለ አዘኑና ስለተከዙ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the hungry and the thirsty we beseech, that God should grant them their daily food. For the sad and the sorrowful we beseech, that God may give them perfect consolation.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ከእሥራታቸው ይፈታቸው ዘንድ ስለ ታሠሩ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር በሰላም ወደ አገራቸው ይመልሳቸው ዘንድ ስለተማረኩ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the prisoners we beseech, that God may loose them from their bonds. For the captives we beseech, that God may restore them to their county in peace.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ትዕግሥትን በጎ ትምህርትንም ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ የድካማቸውንም ፍጹም ዋጋ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስለተሰደዱ ሰዎች እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ፈጥና ያድናቸው ዘንድ ይቅርታውንና ቸርነቱንም ይልክላቸው ዘንድ ስለታመሙትና ስለድውያኑ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For those who were sent away we beseech, that God should grant them patience and good instruction, and give them complete reward for their labor. For the sick and the diseased we beseech, that God should heal them speedily and send upon them mercy and compassion.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ከቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ወገን ስለ ሞቱ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር የዕረፍት ቦታ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር እንዳይቀየማቸው ከመዓትም ተመልሶ ፍጹም ዕረፍትን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስለ በደሉ አባቶቻንናወንድሞቻችን እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For those who have fallen asleep in his holy church we beseech, that God may vouchsafe them a place to rest. For those who have sinned, our fathers and our brothers we beseech, that God cherish not anger against them, but grant them rest and relief from His wrath.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: በሚቫበት ቦታ እግዚአብሔር ዝናቡን ያዘንብ ዘን ድ ስለ ዝናብ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: የወንዙን ውኃ ሙላልን ብለን እግዚአብሔር እነሱን እሰከ ልካቸውና እሰከ ወሰናቸው ይሞላ ዘንድ ስለ ወንዝ ውኃ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_en: For the rains we beseech, that God may send rain on the place that needs it. For the water of the rivers we beseech, that God should fill them unto their due measure and bounds
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ለዘርና ለመከር ሊሆን እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ፍሬዋን ይሰጣት ዘንድ ስለ ምድር ፍሬ እንማልዳለን
verses.text_am: በጸሎት የምንለምንና የምንማልድ ሁላችንንም በሰላም በመንፈስ ይጠብቀን፣ ፍቅርንም ይስጠን ዓይነ ልቡናችንንም ያብራልን፣ ፈቃዱም ሆና ጸሎታችንን ይቀበል ዘንድ ቀርበን እግዚአብሔርን እን ለምነው
verses.text_en: For the fruits of the earth we beseech, that God may grant to the earth her fruit for sowing and for harvest. And all of us who ask and beseech in prayer, may He cover us with the spirit of peace, and give us grace, and enlighten the eyes of our hearts. Let us draw high and ask God to accept our prayers according to His will.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: አውቀን በሀብቱ እናድግ ዘንድ በእርሱም ስም እን መካ ዘንድ በነቢያት በሐዋርያትም መሠረት ላይ እን ታነፅ ዘንድ እንግዲህ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ እንነሣ ቀርበን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርን እንለምነው ወዶ ጸሎታችንን ይቀበል ዘንድ
verses.text_en: Let us therefore rise in the Holy Spirit, growing in His grace, with understanding, glorying in His name and built upon the foundation of the prophets and the apostles. Let us draw high and ask Lord God to accept our prayers according to His will.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ንስግድ (3 ጊዜ) እንስገድ (3 ጊዜ)
verses.text_en: Let's worship (to be repeated thrice )
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ለአብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዘ
verses.text_am: ሠለስቱ አሐዱ (3 ጊዜ) ሦስት ሲሆኑ አንድ ለሚሆኑ ለአብና ለወልድ ለመንፈስ ቅዱስም (3 ጊዜ)
verses.text_en: The Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, three in one. (to be repeated thrice)
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ሰላም ለኪ ሰላምታ ይገባቫል
verses.text_en: Peace be unto thee:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ማኅደረ መለኮት የመለኮት ማደሪያ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን
verses.text_en: Holy church, dwelling-place of the Godhead.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰአሊ ለነ ለምኝልን
verses.text_en: Ask for us:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ድንግል ማርያም ወላዲተ አምላክ አምላክን የወለድሸ ድንግል ማርያም
verses.text_en: Virgin Mary, mother of God,
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አንቲ ውእቱ አንቺ ነሸ
verses.text_en: Thou art:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ማዕጠንት ዘወርቅ እንተ ፆርኪ ፍሕመ እሳት ቡሩክ ዘነሥዓ እመቅደስ ዘይሠሪ ኃጢአተ ወይደመስስ
verses.text_am: ቡሩክ ከቤተ መቅደስ የተቀበላት የእሣትን ፍሕም የተቨከምቨ የወርቅ ጥና አንቺ ነቨ፤
verses.text_en: the golden censer which didst bear the coal of fire which the blessed took from the sanctuary,
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ጌጋየ ዝውእቱ ዘእግዚአብሔር ቃል ዘተሰብአ እምኔኪ ዘአዕረገ ለአቡሁ ርእሶ ዕጣነ ወመሥዋእተ
verses.text_am: ኃጢአትን የሚያስተሰርይ በደልንም የሚያጠፋ ይኸውም ካንቺ ሰው የሆነ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው
verses.text_en: and which forgiveth sin and blotteth out error, who is God's Word that was made man from thee, who offered Himself to his Father for incense and an acceptable sacrifice.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ሥሙረ። ንሰግድ ለከ ክርስቶስ ምስለ አቡከ ጌር ሰማያዊ ወመንፈስከ ቅዱስ ማሕየዊ እስመ መጻእከ ወአድኀንከነ።
verses.text_am: ክርስቶስ ሆይ ቸር ከሚሆን ከሰማያዊ አባትህ ጋራ መድኃኒት ከሚሆን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ጋራ እንሰግድልሃለን መጥተህ አድኸናልና።
verses.text_en: We worship Thee, Christ, with thy good heavenly Father and thy Holy Spirit, the life- giver, for Thou didst come and save us.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ተዘከር እግዚኦ ለአቡነ . . . ዕቀቦ ዓመታት ብዙኀ ወመዋዕለ ነዊኀ በጽድቅ ወበሰላም። አግርር ፀሮ ታሕታ እገሪሁ የሰአል ለነ ኀበ እግዚአብሔር ከመ ይሥረይ ለነ ኃጣውኢነ።
verses.text_am: አባታችንን . . . አስበው። ረጅም ወራት ብዙ ዘመን በውነትና በፍቅር ጠብቀው። ጠላቶቹን ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ኃጢአታችንንሊያስተሠርይልን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይለምን ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: Remember our father, the blessed . . . Patriarch Keep him for many years and length of days in righteousness and peace. Subject his enemies under his feet so that he may pray for us to God, that He may forgive us our sins.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ካሀን ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: (በመቀባበል ይደገማል) ስብሐት ወክብር ለሥሉስ ቅዱስ ይደሉ ካህን ዲ/ህ ይደልዎሙ ለአብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ካህን አብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኩሎ ጊዜ ይእዜኒ ወዘልፈኒ ወለዓለመ ዓለም
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሜን ልዩ ሦስት ለሚሆን ለአብና ለወልድ ለመንፈስ ቅዱስም ሁልጊዜ ክብር ምስጋና ይገባቸዋል ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ አሜን
verses.text_en: Glory and honor are meet to he Holy Trinity, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit at all times. Both now and ever and world without end. Amen
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ኩሉ ዘኢያፈቅሮ ለእግዚእነ ወመድኃኒነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወዘኢየአምን ልደቶ እማርያም እምቅድስት ድንግል በ፪ኤ ታቦተ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እስከ ምጽአቱ ሐዳስ በከመ ይቤ ጳውሎስ ውጉዘ ለይኩን።
verses.text_am: ጌታችንንና መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን የማይወደው የመን ፈስ ቅዱስ ማደሪያ በሁለት ወገን ድንግል ከምትሆን ከቅድስት ማርያም መወለዱንም የማያምን ሰው ሁሉ እንግዳ እስከሚሆን ምጽአቱ ድረስ ጳውሎስ እንደ ተናገረ የተለየ ይሁን።
verses.text_en: Every one that loves not our Lord and our Saviour Jesus Christ, and believes not in his birth from holy Mary, of twofold vir-ginity, the ark of the Holy Spirit, until His coming again, let him be anathema as Paul said.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: የሐዋርያው የጳውሎስ መልዕክት ወደ ዕብራውያን ሰዎች ምዕራፍ 9፣ ያሪ-�ፍ
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 11 ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥ 12 የዘላለምን ቤዛነት አግኝቶ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ወደ ቅድስት በገዛ ደሙ ገባ እንጂ በፍየሎችና በጥጆች ደም አይደለም።
verses.text_en: [11] But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building; [12] Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 13 የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም በረከሱትም ላይ የተረጨ የጊደር አመድ ሥጋን ለማንጻት የሚቀድሱ ከሆኑ፥ 14 ነውር የሌለው ሆኖ በዘላለም መንፈስ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረበ የክርስቶስ ደም እንዴት ይልቅ ሕያውን እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ ከሞተ ሥራ ሕሊናችሁን ያነጻ ይሆን?
verses.text_en: [13] For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:[14] How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 15 ስለዚህም የፊተኛው ኪዳን ሲጸና ሕግን የተላለፉትን የሚቤዥ ሞት ስለ ሆነ፥ የተጠሩት የዘላለምን ርስት የተስፋ ቃል እንዲቀበሉ እርሱ የአዲስ ኪዳን መካከለኛ ነው። 16 ኑዛዜ ያለ እንደሆነ የተናዛዡን ሞት ማርዳት የግድ ነውና፤ 17 ሰው ሲሞት ኑዛዜው ይጸናልና፥ ተናዛዡ በሕይወት ሲኖር ግን ከቶ አይጠቅምም።
verses.text_en: [15] And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance. [16] For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator. [17] For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 18 ስለዚህም ፊተኛው ኪዳን እንኳ ያለ ደም አልተመረቀም። 19-20 ሙሴም ትእዛዛትን ሁሉ እንደ ሕጉ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ የጥጆችንና የፍየሎችን ደም ከውኃና ከቀይ የበግ ጠጕር ከሂሶጵም ጋር ይዞ። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘላችሁ የኪዳን ደም ይህ ነው ብሎ በመጽሐፉና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ላይ ረጨው።
verses.text_en: [18] Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood. [19] For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people, [20] Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 21 እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ። 22 እንደ ሕጉም ከጥቂቶች በቀር ነገር ሁሉ በደም ይነጻል፥ ደምም ሳይፈስ ስርየት የለም። 23 እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያሉትን የሚመስለው ነገር በዚህ ሊነጻ እንጂ በሰማያት ያሉቱ ራሳቸው ከእርሱ ይልቅ በሚበልጥ መስዋዕት ሊነጹ የግድ ነበረ።
verses.text_en: [21] Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry. [22] And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission. [23] It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 24 ክርስቶስ በእጅ ወደ ተሰራች፥ የእውነተኛይቱ ምሳሌ ወደ ምትሆን ቅድስት አልገባምና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ እኛ አሁን ይታይ ዘንድ ወደ እርስዋ ወደ ሰማይ ገባ። 25 ሊቀ ካህናትም በየዓመቱ የሌላውን ደም ይዞ ወደ ቅድስት እንደሚገባ፥ ራሱን ብዙ ጊዜ ሊያቀርብ አልገባም፤
verses.text_en: [24] For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us: [25] Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 26 እንዲህ ቢሆንስ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ መከራ ሊቀበል ባስፈለገው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን በዓለም ፍጻሜ ራሱን በመሠዋት ኃጢአትን ሊሽር አንድ ጊዜ ተገልጦአል። 27 ለሰዎችም አንድ ጊዜ መሞት ከእርሱ በኋላም ፍርድ እንደ ተመደበባቸው፥ 28 እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ፥ የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ሊሸከም አንድ ጊዜ ከተሰዋ በኋላ፥ ያድናቸው ዘንድ ለሚጠባበቁት ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ያለ ኃጢአት ይታይላቸዋል።
verses.text_en: [26] For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself. [27] And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment: [28] So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ ሐዋርያ ጳውሎስ ሠናየ መልእክት ፈዋሴ ዱያን ዘነሳእከ አክሊለ ሰአል ወጸሊ በእንቲአነ ያድኅን ነፍሳተነ በብዝኃ ሣህሉ ወምሕረቱ በእንተ ስሙ ቅዱስ
verses.text_am: አክሊለ ሰማዕታትን የተቀበልህ ድውያንን የምታድን መልእክትህ የበጀ ክቡር የምትሆን ጳውሎስ ሆይ ስለእኛ ለምንልን በይቅርታው ቸርነቱ ብዛት ሰውነታችንን ይድን ዘንድ በክብር ስሙ ስለአመንን
verses.text_en: Holy Apostle Paul, good messenger, healer of the sick, who hast received the crown, ask and pray for us in order that he may save our souls in the multitude of his mercies and in his pity for his holy name's sake.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ካሀን ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ነገር ዘእመልእክተ ....... ረድኡ ወሐዋርያሁ ለእግዚእነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸሎቱ ወበረከቱ የሃሉ ምስለ ኩልነ ሕዝበ ክርስቲያን ለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን።
verses.text_am: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያው ረድኡ ከሚሆን መልእክት የተገኘ ቃል ይህ ነው ጸሎቱ በረከቱ በሕዝበ ክርስቲያኑ ይኑር ለዘላለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: The word from the Epistle of the disciple and apostle of our Lord Jesus Christ, ___________, may his prayer and blessing be on our fellow Christians for ever. Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: 1ኛ የጴጥሮስ መልዕክት ምዕራፍ ፍ፣ ሪ-ያሪ
verses.text_en: 1s Peter 4:1-11
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 1-2 ክርስቶስም በሥጋ ስለ እኛ መከራን ስለተቀበለ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በሥጋ ልትኖሩ በቀረላችሁ ዘመን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ እንጂ እንደ ሰው ምኞት እንዳትኖሩ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ ያን አሳብ እንደ ዕቃ ጦር አድርጋችሁ ያዙት፥ በሥጋ መከራን የተቀበለ ኃጢአትን ትቶአልና።
verses.text_en: [1] Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin; [2] That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 3 የአሕዛብን ፈቃድ ያደረጋችሁበት በመዳራትና በሥጋ ምኞትም በስካርም በዘፈንም ያለ ልክም በመጠጣት ነውርም ባለበት በጣዖት ማምለክ የተመላለሳችሁበት ያለፈው ዘመን ይበቃልና። 4 በዚህም ነገር ወደዚያ መዳራት ብዛት ከእነርሱ ጋር ስለማትሮጡ እየተሳደቡ ይደነቃሉ፤
verses.text_en: [3] For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries: [4] Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 5 ግን እነርሱ በሕያዋንና በሙታን ላይ ሊፈርድ ለተዘጋጀው መልስ ይሰጣሉ። 6 እንደሰዎች በሥጋ እንዲፈረድባቸው በመንፈስ ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲኖሩ ስለዚህ ምክንያት ወንጌል ለሙታን ደግሞ ተሰብኮላቸው ነበርና። 7 ዳሩ ግን የነገር ሁሉ መጨረሻ ቀርቦአል። እንግዲህ እንደ ባለ አእምሮ አስቡ፥
verses.text_en: [5] Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead. [6] For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit. [7] But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 8 ትጸልዩም ዘንድ በመጠን ኑሩ፤ ፍቅር የኃጢአትን ብዛት ይሸፍናልና ከሁሉ በፊት እርስ በርሳችሁ አጥብቃችሁ ተዋደዱ።9 ያለ ማንጐራጐር እርስ በርሳችሁ እንግድነትን ተቀባበሉ፤ 10 ልዩ ልዩን የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ደጋግ መጋቢዎች እንደ መሆናችሁ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁ የጸጋን ስጦታ እንደ ተቀበላችሁ መጠን በዚያው ጸጋ እርስ በርሳችሁ አገልግሉ፤
verses.text_en: [8] And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins. [9] Use hospitality one to another without grudging. [10] As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 11 ማንም ሰው የሚናገር ቢሆን፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ይናገር፤ የሚያገለግልም ቢሆን፥ እግዚአብሔር በሚሰጠኝ ኃይል ነው ብሎ ያገልግል፤ ክብርና ሥልጣን እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ለእርሱ በሚሆነው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል እግዚአብሔር በነገር ሁሉ ይከብር ዘንድ፤ አሜን።
verses.text_en: [11] If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ ሥሉስ ዘኅቡር ህላዌከ ዕቀብ ማኅበረነ በእንተ ቅዱሳን ኅሩያን አርዳኢከ ናዝዘነ በሣህልከ በእንተ ቅዱስ ሥምከ።
verses.text_am: ባሕርይህ አንድ የሚሆን ልዩ ሦስት ሆይ አንድነታችንን ጠብቅ ስለ ተመረጡ ክቡራን ደቀ መዛሙርትህ በይቅርታህ አጽናን ክቡር ስለሚሆን ስለ ስምህ ብለህ።
verses.text_en: Holy con substantial Trinity, preserve our congregation for Thy holy elect disciples' sake: comfort us in Thee mercy, for Thy holy name's sake.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.

verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.

verses.text_geez: ካሀን ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all. And with Thy spirit.

verses.text_geez: ነቅሕ ንጹሕ ዘእምአንቅዕተ ሕግ ንጹሓን ዝውእቱ ዜና ግብሮሙ ለሐዋርያት በረከተ ጸሎቶሙ የሀሉ ምስለ ኩልነ ሕዝበ ክርስቲያን ለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን።
verses.text_am: ንጹሓን ከሚሆኑ ከሕግ ምንጮች የተገኘ ጥሩ ምንጭ ይኸውም የሐዋርያት የሥራቸው ነገር ነው የጸሎታቸው በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን ለዘላለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: A pure fountain which is from the pure fountains of the law, to wit the history of the acts of the apostles. The blessing of their prayer be with our people for ever. Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ግብረ ሐዋርያት የሐዋርያት ሥራ ምዕራፍ �ፍ፣ ያሪ
verses.text_en: Acts 28:11
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 11 ከሦስት ወርም በኋላ በደሴቲቱ ከርሞ በነበረው በእስክንድርያው መርከብ ተነሣን፥ በእርሱም የዲዮስቆሮስ አላማ ነበረበት።12 ወደ ሰራኩስም በገባን ጊዜ ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጥን፤ 13 ከዚያም እየተዛወርን ወደ ሬጊዩም ደረስን። ከአንድ ቀን በኋላም የደቡብ ነፋስ በነፈሰ ጊዜ በሁለተኛው ቀን ወደ ፑቲዮሉስ መጣን።
verses.text_en: [11] And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux. [12] And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days. [13] And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 14 በዚያም ወንድሞችን አግኝተን በእነርሱ ዘንድ ሰባት ቀን እንድንቀመጥ ለመኑን፤ እንዲሁም ወደ ሮሜ መጣን። 15 ከዚያም ወንድሞች ስለ እኛ ሰምተው እስከ አፍዩስ ፋሩስና ሦስት ማደሪያ እስከሚባለው ሊቀበሉን ወጡ፥ ጳውሎስም ባያቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ ልቡም ተጽናና።
verses.text_en: [14] Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome. [15] And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appiiforum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 16 ወደ ሮሜም በገባን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ከሚጠብቀው ወታደር ጋር ለብቻው ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ተፈቀደለት። 17 ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ጳውሎስ የአይሁድን ታላላቆች ወደ እርሱ ጠራ፤ በተሰበሰቡም ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ሕዝቡን ወይም የአባቶችን ሥርዓት የሚቃወም አንዳች ሳላደርግ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ታሰርሁ በሮማውያን እጅ አሳልፈው ሰጡኝ።
verses.text_en: [16] And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him. [17] And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 18 እነርሱም መርምረው ለሞት የሚገባ ምክንያት ስላልነበረብኝ ሊፈቱኝ አሰቡ፤ 19 አይሁድ ግን በተቃወሙ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ እንድል ግድ ሆነብኝ እንጂ ሕዝቤን የምከስበት ነገር ኖሮኝ አይደለም። 20 ስለዚህም ምክንያት አያችሁና እነግራችሁ ዘንድ ጠራኋችሁ፤ ስለ እስራኤል ተስፋ ይህን ሰንሰለት ለብሻለሁና።
verses.text_en: [18] Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me. [19] But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of. [20] For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 21 እነርሱም። እኛ ከይሁዳ ስለ አንተ ደብዳቤ አልተቀበልንም፥ ከወንድሞችም አንድ ስንኳ መጥቶ ስለ አንተ ክፉ ነገር አላወራልንም ወይም አልተናገረብህም። 22 ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ወገን በየስፍራው ሁሉ እንዲቃወሙ በእኛ ዘንድ ታውቆአልና የምታስበውን ከአንተ እንሰማ ዘንድ እንፈቅዳለን አሉት።
verses.text_en: [21] And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee. [22] But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

verses.text_geez: ዝብ ሕዝብ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ አንተ አብ አኃዜ ኩሉ።

verses.text_am: ካሀን የምትሆኝ አምላክን የወለድሸ የክርስቶስ እናት ሆይ ኃጢአታችንን ያስተሠርይልን ዘንድ ወደ ልጅሸ ወደ ወዳጅሸ ወደ ላይ ጸሎታችንን አሳርጊ።

verses.text_am: ካሀን ንጽሕት ድንግል ሆይ ለነፍሳችን ይቅርታን ያደርግ ዘንድ ኃጢአታችንንም ያስተሠርይልን ዘንድ ወደ ጌታችን ለምኝልን ።
verses.text_en: O Virgin pure, plead for us unto our Lord that He may have mercy upon our souls and forgive us our sin.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሜን
verses.text_en: Amen.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ካሀን በእውነት ለሰው ወገን አማላጅ የምትሆኝ፤ አምላክን የወለድሸ ንጽሕት ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም ሆይ ደስ ይበልሸ።
verses.text_en: Rejoice, O Virgin Mary, parent of God, holy and pure, very pleader for the race of mankind.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ደስ ይበልሸ
verses.text_en: Rejoice.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ካሀን የኃጢአታችንን ሥርየት ይሰጠን ዘንድ በልጅሸ በክርስቶስ ፊት ለምኝልን።
verses.text_en: Plead for us before Christ thy Son, that He may vouchsafe us remission of our sins.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሜን
verses.text_en: Amen.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ካሀን በእውነት ንግሥት የምትሆኝ ንጽሕት ድንግል ሆይ ደስ ይበልሸ
verses.text_am: ሕዝብ:- ደስ ይበልሸ ካሀን የባሕርያችን መመኪያ ሆይ ደስ ይበልሸ ሕዝብ:- ደስ ይበልሸ
verses.text_en: Rejoice, O Virgin pure, very Queen. Rejoice. Rejoice, O pride of our kind. Rejoice.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ካሀን አምላካችን አማኑኤልን የወለድሸልን ሆይ ደስ ይበልሸ
verses.text_en: Rejoice, O thou that barest for us Emmanuel our God.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ደስ ይበልሸ
verses.text_en: Rejoice.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ካሀን በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት እውነተኛ አስታራቂ ሆነሸ ታስቢን ዘንድ እንለምንሻለን ለነፍሳችን ይቅርታን ያደርግልን ዘንድ ኃጢአታችንንም ያስተሠርይልን ዘንድ
verses.text_am: አሜን ሕዝብ:-
verses.text_en: We ask thee to remember us, O true Mediatrix, before our Lord Jesus Christ that He may have mercy upon our souls and forgive us our sins. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ካሀባች ዝውእቱ ጊዜ ባርኮት ወዝ ውእቱ ጊዜ ዕጣን ኅሩይ ጊዜ ሰብሖቱ ለመድኃኒነ መፍቀሬ ሰብእ ክርስቶስ።
verses.text_am: የማመስገን ጊዜ ይህ ነው።የተመረጠ የዕጣን ጊዜም ይህ ነው። ሰውን ወዳጅ መድኃኒታችንን ክርስቶስን ማመስገኛ ጊዜ።
verses.text_en: This is the time of blessing; this is the time of chosen incense, the time of the praise of our Savior, lover of man, Christ.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ዕጣን ይእቲ ማርያም ዕጣን ውእቱ እስመ ዘውስተ ከርሣ ዘይትዐዝ እምኩሉ ዕጣን ዘወለደቶ መጽአ ወአድኀነነ
verses.text_am: ማርያም ዕጣን ናት፤ ዕጣን እርሱ ነው። በማኅጸንዋ ያደረው ከተመረጠ ዕጣን ሁሉ የሚቨት ነውና፤ የወለደችው መጥቶ አዳነን
verses.text_en: Mary is the incense, and the incense is He, because he who was in her womb is more fragrant than all chosen incense. He whom she bare came and saved us.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ካሀባች ዕፍረት ምዑዝ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ንዑ ንስግድ ሎቱ ወንዕቀብ ትእዛዛቲሁ ከመ ይሥረይ ለነ ኃጣውኢነ።
verses.text_am: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መዓዛ ያለው ቨቱ ነው ፤ ኑ እንስገድለት ትእዛዞቹንም እንጠብቅ ኃጢአታችንን ያስተሠርይልን ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: The fragrant ointment is Jesus Chris. O! come let us worship Him and keep His commandments that He may forgive us our sins.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ሕዝብ
verses.text_am: ተውህቦ ምሕረት ለሚካኤል ወብሥራት ለገብርኤል ወሀብተ ሰማያት ለማርያም ድንግል ለሚካኤል ምሕረት ተሰጠው ለገብርኤልም ማብሠር፤ ለድንግል ማርያም ሰማያዊ ሀብት።
verses.text_en: To Michael was given mercy, and glad tidings to Gabriel, and a heavenly gift to the Virgin Mary.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ተውህቦ ልቡና ለዳዊት ወጥበብ ለሰሎሞን ወቀርነ ቅብዕ ለሳሙኤል እስመ ውእቱ ዘይቀብዕ ነገሥተ።
verses.text_am: ለዳዊት ልቡና ለሰሎሞንም ጥበብ ለሳሙኤልም ነገሥታቱን የቀባ እርሱ ነውና የቨቱ ቀንድ ተሰጠው።
verses.text_en: To David was given understanding, and wisdom to Solomon, and an horn of oil to Samuel for he was the anointer of kings.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ተውህቦ መራጉት ለአቡነ ጴጥሮስ ወድንግልና ለዮሐንስ ወመልእክት ለአቡነ ጳውሎስ እሰመ ውእቱ ብርሃና ለቤተ ክርስቲያን።
verses.text_am: ለአባታችን ለጴጥሮስ መከፈቻ ለዮሐንስም ድንግልና ለአባታችን ለጳውሎስም የቤተ ክርስቲያን ብርሃኑ እርሱ ነውና መልእከት ተሰጠው።
verses.text_en: To our father Peter were given the keys, and virginity to John, and apostleship to our father Paul, for he was the light of the church.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ዕፍረት ምዕዝት ይእቲ ማርያም እስመ ዘውስተ ከርሣ ዘይትሌዐል እምኩሉ ዕጣን መጽአ ወተሠገወ እምኔሃ።
verses.text_am: መዓዛ ያላት ቨቱ ማርያም ናት፤ በማኅጸንዋ ያለው ከዕጣን ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ነውና መጥቶ ከእርስዋ ሰው ሆነ።
verses.text_en: The fragrant ointment is Mary, for he that was in her womb, who is more fragrant than all incense, came and was incarnate of her.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ሕዝብ
verses.text_am: ለማርያም ድንግል ንጽሕት ሠምራ አብ ወአሠርገዋ ደብተራ ለማኅደረ ፍቁር ወልዱ። ንጽሕት ድንግል ማርያምን አብ ወደዳት ለተወደደ ልጁም ማደሪያ ልትሆን አስጌጣት።
verses.text_en: In Mary virgin pure the Father was well- pleased, and he decked her to be a tabernacle for the habitation of his beloved Son.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ተውህቦ ሕግ ለሙሴ ወክህነት ለአሮን ተውህቦ ዕጣን ኅሩይ ለዘካርያስ ካህን።
verses.text_am: ለሙሴ ሕግ ለአሮንም ከህነት ተሰጠው። ለካህኑ ለዘካርያስም የተመረጠ ዕጣን ተሰጠው
verses.text_en: To Moses was given the law, and priesthood to Aaron. To Zacharias the priest was given chosen incense.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ደብተራ ስምዕ ገብርዋ በከመ ነገረ እግዚእ ወአሮን ካህን በማእከላ ያዐርግ ዕጣነ ኅሩየ።
verses.text_am: የምስከር ድንኳን አደረ�ት። ጌታ እነደተናገረ ካህኑ አሮንም በመካከላቸው የተመረጠው ዕጣን ያሳርጋል።
verses.text_en: They made a tabernacle of testimony according to the word of God; and Aaron the priest, in the midst thereof, made the chosen incense to go up.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ካህናት
verses.text_am: ሱራፌል ይሰግዱ ሎቱ ወኪሩቤል ይሴብሕዎ ይጸርሑ እንዘ ይብሉ። ሱራፌል ይስግዱለታል ኪሩቤልም ያመሰግኑታል። እንዲህ እያሉ ይዘምራሉ።
verses.text_en: The seraphim worship him, and cherubim praise him and cry saying:
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር በኀበ አእላፍ ወክቡር በውስተ ረበዋት።
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር በአእላፍ መላእክት ዘንድ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ነው። በአለቆችም ዘንድ ክቡር ነውቸ
verses.text_en: Holy Holy Holy is the Lord among the thousands and honored among the tens of thousands.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: በኅብረት አንተ ውእቱ ዕጣን ኦ መድኃኒነ እስመ መጻእከ ወአድኃንከነ ተሣሃለነ።
verses.text_am: መድኃኒታችን ሆይ! ዕጣን አንተ ነህ፤ መጥተህ አድነኸናልና ይቅር በለን።
verses.text_en: Thou art the incense, O our savior, for Thou didst come and save us. Have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው ዘኢይመውት ዘተወልደ እማርያም እምቅድስት ድንግል ተሣሃለነ እግዚኦ። እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው
verses.text_am: የማይሞት ከቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም የተወለደ፥ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን።
verses.text_en: ቅዱስ / Holy ሕዝብ/People God, holy Mighty, holy Living, Immortal, who was born from the holy Virgin Mary, have mercy upon us, Lord.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው ዘኢይመውት ዘተጠምቀ በዮርዳናስ ወተሰቅለ ዲበ ዕፀ መስቀል ተሣሃለነ እግዚኦ።
verses.text_am: ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው የማይሞት በዮርዳናስ የተጠመቀ በመስቀል ላይ የተሰቀለ፥ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን።
verses.text_en: Holy God, holy Mighty, Holy Living, Immortal, who was baptized in Jordan and crucified on the tree of the cross, have mercy upon us, Lord.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው ዘኢይመውት ዘተንሥአ እሙታን አመ ሣልስት
verses.text_am: ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ኃያል ቅዱስ ሕያው የማይሞት በሦስተኛው ቀን ከሙታን ተለይቶ የተነሣ
verses.text_en: Holy God, holy Mighty, holy Living, Immortal, who didst rise from the dead on the third day,
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ዕለት ዐርገ በስብሐት ውስተ ሰማያት ወነበረ በየማነ አቡሁ ዳግመ ይመጽእ በስብሐት ይኮንን ሕያዋነ ወሙታነ፤ ተሣሃለነ እግዚኦ።
verses.text_am: በምስጋና ወደ ሰማይ ወጣ በአባቱም ቀኝ ተቀመጠ ዳግመኛም ይመጣል በሕያዋንና በሙታን ይፈርድ ዘንድ፥ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን።
verses.text_en: ascend into heaven in glory, sit at the right hand of thy Father and again wilt come in glory to judge the quick and the dead, have mercy upon us, Lord.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ስብሐት ለአብ ስብሐት ለወልድ ስብሐት ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ ይእዜኒ ወዘልፈኒ ወለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን ወአሜን ለይኩን ለይኩን።
verses.text_am: ለአብ ምስጋና ይሁን ለወልድም ምስጋና ይሁን ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ ምስጋና ይሁን ዛሬም ዘወትርም ለዘለዓለሙ አሜን ።
verses.text_en: Glory be to the Father, glory be to the Son, glory be to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever and world without end. Amen and Amen, so be it, so be it.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ቅዱስ ሥሉስ እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ተሣሃለነ።
verses.text_am: ልዩ ሦስት ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ሆይ ይቅር በለን።
verses.text_en: O holy Trinity, living God have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ጸጋ ዘእግዚአብሔር የሃሉ ምስሌክሙ የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ከናንተ ጋራ ይሁን
verses.text_en: The grace of God be with you.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: And with Thy spirit
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ንሰብሖ ለአምላክነ ፈጣሪያችንን እናመስግን
verses.text_en: Let us glory our God.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ርቱዕ ይደሉ እውነት ነው ይገባል አጽንዑ ሕሊና ልብክሙ የልባችሁን አሳብ አጽኑ
verses.text_en: It is right, it is just. ካህን/Priest Strengthen the thought of your heart.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ብነ ኀበ እግዚአብሔር አቡነ ዘበሰማያት አቡነ ዘበሰማያት፤ አቡነ ዘበሰማያት፤ ኢታብአነ እግዚኦ ውስተ መንሱት።
verses.text_am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አለን። አባታችን ሆይ አባታችን ሆይ አባታችን ሆይ አቤቱ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን።
verses.text_en: We lift them unto the Lord our God. Our Father who art in heaven, Our Father who art in heaven, Our Father who art in heaven, lead us not into temptation.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ካህኑ የኪዳን ጸሎት “እግዚአብሔር አብ ,,,,,,,,“ የሚለውን በንባብ ያሰማሉ
verses.text_en: The priest will read the “O God the Father…” Prayer of the Covenant.
verses.source_note: rubric; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ኪያከ ንሴብሕ እግዚኦ አቤቱ እናመስግንሃለን
verses.text_en: Oh, we thank you Thee
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ካህኑ የኪዳን ጸሎት “እግዚኦ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ, ….…. ” የሚለውን በንባብ ያሰማሉ
verses.text_am: ኪያከ ንዌድስ እግዚኦ አቤቱ አንተን እናመስግናለን
verses.text_en: The priest will read the “O Lord, Jesus Christ” Prayer of the Covenant. ሕዝብ/People Oh Lord, we praise Thee
verses.source_note: rubric

verses.text_am: ካህኑ የኪዳን ጸሎት “ንሤልስ ለከ ዘንተ ቅዱስ ,,,,,,,,“ የሚለውን በንባብ ያሰማሉ
verses.text_en: The priest will read “ Thrice over …” prayer of the covenant.
verses.source_note: rubric; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሜን
verses.text_en: Amen
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: አቡነ ዘበሰማያት ይትቀደስ ስምከ . . . አባታችን ሆይ በሰማያት የምትናር . . .
verses.text_am: በሰላመ ገብርኤል መልአክ ኦ እግዚእትየ . . . እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም ሆይ. . .
verses.text_en: Our Father in Haven . . . Hail Mary . . .
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ኦ ሥሉስ ቅዱስ መሐረነ፥ ኦ ሥሉስ ቅዱስ መሐከነ፥ ኦ ሥሉስ ቅዱስ ተሣሃለነ
verses.text_am: ልዩ ሦስት ሆይ ማረን፥ ልዩ ሦስት ሆይ ራራልን፥ ልዩ ሦስት ሆይ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: O! Holy Trinity, Pity us, O! Holy Trinity, Spare us, O! Holy Trinity, have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ተፈሥሒ ተፈሥሒ ተፈሥሒ ኦ ማርያም ድንግል ምልዕተ ጸጋ። ጸጋን የተሞላቨ ድንግል ማርያም ሆይ ደስ ይበልቨ ደስ ይበልቨ ደስ ይበልቨ
verses.text_en: Rejoice rejoice rejoice, O! Virgin Mary, full of grace
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ምስሌኪ እግዚአብሔር ካንቺ ጋራ ነው
verses.text_en: The Lord is with Thee.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቡሩክት አንቲ እምአንስት ከሴቶች ተለይተቨ የተባረክቨ ነቨ።
verses.text_en: Blessed art Thou among women:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ወቡሩክ ፍሬ ከርሥኪ የማኅጸንቨም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።
verses.text_en: And blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰአሊ ለነ ኀበ ክርስቶስ ወልድኪ ከልጅቨ ከክርስቶስ ዘንድ ለምኝልን።
verses.text_en: Pray for us to Christ thy Son.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ከመ ይሥረይ ለነ ኃጣውኢነ ኃጢአታችንን ያስተሠርይልን ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: To forgive us our sins.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አቤቱ ፈጣሪያችን እግዚአብሔር ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆይ! ቅዱሳን የሚሆኑ ደቀመዛሙርትህንና ንጹሓን ለሐዋርያት እንዲህ ያልሃቸው እናንተ የምታዩትን ያዩ ዘንድ ብዙ ነቢያት ጻድቃን ወደዱ አላዩም። እናንተ ዛሬ የምትሰሙትንም ይሰሙ ዘንድ ወደዱ አልሰሙም።
verses.text_en: O Lord Jesus Christ, our God, who didst say to Thy holy disciples and Thy pure apostles: Many prophets and righteous men have desired to see the things which Ye see and have not seen them, and have desired to hear the things which Ye hear and have not heard them,
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: የእናንተ ያዩ ዓይናቻችሁና የሰሙ ጆሮቻችሁ ግን የተመሰገኑ ናቸው። እኛንም እንደ እነሱ የበቃን አድርገን፤ በቅዱሳን ጸሎት የከበረ ወንጌልን ቃል ሰምተን እንሠራ ዘንድ።
verses.text_en: but You, blessed are Your eyes that have seen and you ears that have heard, Do Thou make us also like them meet to hear and to do the word of Thy Holy Gospel through the prayer of the saints.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ጸልዩ በእንተ ወንጌል ቅዱስ። ክቡር ስለሚሆን ወንጌል ጸልዩ።
verses.text_en: Pray for the Holy Gospel
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ይረስየነ ድልዋነ ለሰሚዐ ወንጌል ቅዱስ። የከበረ ወንጌልን ለመስማት የበቃን ያድርገን።
verses.text_en: May He make us meet to hear the Holy Gospel.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እምአፈ ደቂቅ ወሕጻናት አስተዳሎከ ስብሐተ። በእንተ ጸላኢ። ከመ ትንሥቶ ለጸላኢ ወለገፋኢ። መዝ. ፳፥፪
verses.text_am: ከሕጻናትና ከሚጠቡ ልጆች አፍ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ ስለ ጠላትህ፥ ጠላትንና ቂመኛን ለማጥፋት። መዝ. 8፥2
verses.text_en: Out of the mouth of babes and suckings has Thou perfected praise, in spite of Thine enemies, to silence the enemy and the avenger. Psalms 8:2
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ሃሌ ሉያ! ቁሙ ወአጽምዑ ወንጌለ ቅዱሰ ዜናሁ ለእግዚእነ ወመድኃኒነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ።
verses.text_am: ሃሌ ሉያ! ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የተናገረውን ቅዱስ ወንጌል ቁማችሁ ስሙ።
verses.text_en: Halleluiah, stand up and hearken to the Holy Gospel, the message of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ምስለ ኩልክሙ። እግዚአብሔር አድሮባችሁ ይኑር።
verses.text_en: The Lord be with you all.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስለ መንፈስከ። ከመንፈስህ ጋር።
verses.text_en: And with Thy spirit
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ወንጌል ቅዱስ፤ ዘዜነወ ሉቃስ ቃለ ወልደ እግዚአብሔር
verses.text_am: ሉቃስ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ቃል የሚሆን ቅዱስ ወንጌል
verses.text_en: The Holy gospel according to Luke the Word of the Son of God.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ስብሐት ለከ ክርስቶስ እግዚእየ ወአምላኪየ ኩሎ ጊዜ
verses.text_am: ጌታዬና አምላኬ ክርስቶስ ሆይ ሁልጊዜ ለአንተ ምስጋና ይገባል።
verses.text_en: Glory be to Thee, Christ my Lord and my God, at all times.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ተፈሥሑ በእግዚአብሔር ዘረድአነ ወየብቡ ለአምላከ ያዕቆብ፤ ንሥኡ መዝሙረ ወሀቡ ከበሮ መዝሙር ሐዋዝ ዘምስለ መሰንቆ
verses.text_am: በረዳን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላቸሁ የያዕቆብምንም አምላክ አመስግኑ መዝሙሩን ያዙ፤ ከበሮውንም ስጡ መዝሙር ከበገና ጋራ የተስማማ ነው።
verses.text_en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob. Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ነዋ ወንጌለ መንግሥት። ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የምታገባ ወንጌል እነሆ!
verses.text_en: Behold the Gospel of the kingdom of heaven.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: መንግሥቶ ወጽድቆ ዘአወፈየኒ አወፈይኩከ። መንግሥቱንና ጽድቁን የሰጠኝን ሰጠኹኽቸ
verses.text_en: His kingdom and His righteousness which he delivered to me: I deliver to you.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ነስሑ ወእመኑ እስመ ቀርበት መንግሥተ ሰማያት
verses.text_am: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና ንስሓ ግቡ።
verses.text_en: Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ባርክ እግዚኦ ነገር ዘእምወንጌለ ሉቃስ ረድኡ ወሐዋርያሁ ለእግዚእነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወልደ እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ሎቱ ስብሐት ወትረ እስከ ለዓለም ዓለም አሜን።
verses.text_am: የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ልጅ የጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያውና ደቀ መዝሙሩ ከሚሆን ሉቃስ ወንጌል የተገኘው ቃል አባቱ ባርክ ምስጋና ዘወትር ገንዘቡ ነው ለዘለዓለሙ አሜን።
verses.text_en: Bless, O Lord, the portion of the gospel of Luke the disciple and apostle of our Lord Jesus Christ the Son of the living God ; to Him be glory continually, and unto the ages of ages. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: የዕለቱ ወንጌል
verses.text_am: የሉቃስ ወንጌል ፩፱፥፳፰-፵፰
verses.text_en: Reading the Gospel according to Luke 19:28 - 48
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: 28 ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣ ይቀድማቸው ነበር። 29 ደብረ ዘይትም በሚባል ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከና።30 በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፥ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።
verses.text_en: [28] And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem. [29] And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, [30] Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 31 ማንም። ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? ብሎ ቢጠይቃችሁ፥ እንዲሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉ አላቸው። 32 የተላኩትም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ። 33 እነርሱም ውርንጫውን ሲፈቱ ጌቶቹ። ውርንጫውን ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? አሉአቸውም 34 እነርሱም። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል አሉ።
verses.text_en: [31] And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him. [32] And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them. [33] And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt? [34] And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 35 ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፥ በውርንጫውም ላይ ልብሳቸውን ጭነው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት። 36 ሲሄድም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ያነጥፉ ነበር። 37 ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቍልቍለትም አሁን በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁላቸው ደስ እያላቸው ተአምራትን ሁሉ ስላዩ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ሊያመሰግኑ ጀምረው።
verses.text_en: [35] And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon. [36] And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way. [37] And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 38 በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው፤ በሰማይ ሰላም በአርያምም ክብር አሉ። 39 ከሕዝብም መካከል ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው አሉት። 40 መልሶም። እላችኋለሁ፥ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች ይጮኻሉ አላቸው።
verses.text_en: [38] Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest. [39] And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples. [40] And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 41 ሲቀርብም ከተማይቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፥ 42 እንዲህ እያለ። ለሰላምሽ የሚሆነውን በዚህ ቀን አንቺስ ስንኳ ብታውቂ፤ አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሮአል። 43 ወራት ይመጣብሻልና፥ ጠላቶችሽም ቅጥር ይቀጥሩብሻል ይከቡሻልም በየበኵሉም ያስጨንቁሻል፤
verses.text_en: [41] And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it, [42] Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes. [43] For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 44 አንቺንም በአንቺም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ልጆችሽን ወደ ታች ይጥላሉ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፥ የመጐብኘትሽን ዘመን አላወቅሽምና። 45 ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በእርሱ የሚሸጡትን የሚገዙትንም ያወጣ ጀመር፤ 46 እርሱም። ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት አላቸው።
verses.text_en: [44] And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation. [45] And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought; [46] Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: 47 ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ 48 የሚያደርጉበትንም አጡ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙት ተንጠልጥለውበት ነበርና።
verses.text_en: [47] And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him, [48] And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ይቀልል ኅልፈተ ሰማይ ወምድር እምትደቅ አሐቲ ቃል እምኦሪት ወእምነቢያት።
verses.text_am: ከኦሪትና ከነቢያት አንዲቱ ቃል ብትወድቅ የሰማይና የምድር ማለፍ ይቀላል።
verses.text_en: It is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fall.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: መኑ ይመስለከ እምነ አማልክት እግዚኦ አንተ ውእቱ ዘትገብር መንክረ አርአይኮሙ ለሕዝብከ ኃይለከ ወአድኀን ኮሙ ለሕዝብከ በመዝራዕትከ፤ ሖርከ ውስተ ሲኦል ወአዕረገ ፄዋ እምህየ ወጸጎከነ ምዕረ ዳግመ ግዕዛነ እስመ መጻእከ ወአድኀንከነ።
verses.text_am: አቤቱ ከአማልክት ወገን የሚመስለህ ማነው: ተአምራትን የምታደርግ አንኀ ነህ ለወገናችህ ኃይልህን አሳየሃቸው ወገናችህንም በክንድህ አዳንሃቸው ወደ ሲኦል ሄደህ ከዚያ ምርኮን አወጣህ ዳግመኛም አንድ ጊዜ ነጻነትን ስጠኸን።
verses.text_en: Who is like unto Thee, O Lord, among the gods? Thou art the God that does wonders, Thou has declared Thy strength among the people. With Thine arm Thou redeemed Thy people. Thou went into Hades and the captives rose up from there, and Thou did grant us again to be set free, for Thou came and saved us.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: በእንተ ዝንቱ ንሴብሐከ ወንጸርሕ ኀቤከ እንዘ ንብል ቡሩክ አንተ እግዚኦ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስመ መጻእከ ወአድኀንከነ።
verses.text_am: መጥተህ አድነኸናልና ስለዚህ እናመሰግንሃለን ፤ አቤቱ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆይ ቡሩክ ነህ እያልን እንጮኻለን መጥተህ አድነኸናልናቸ
verses.text_en: For this cause we glorify Thee and cry unto Thee saying, Blessed art Thou, Lord Jesus Christ, for Thou did come and save us.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: ፃኡ ንዑሰ ክርስቲያን የክርስቲያን ታናሾች የሆናችሁ ውጡ
verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Go forth, Ye catechumens. Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ካሀን ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስለ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ዳግመኛም ሁሉን የሚይዝ የጌታችንና
verses.text_am: የመድኃኒታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አባት እግዚአብሔርን እንማልዳለን፤ ሰው ወዳጅ ሆይ ከቸርነትህ እንቫለን እንለምናለን።
verses.text_en: Again we beseech the almighty God, the Father of our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, we ask and entreat of Thy goodness. O lover of man,
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: አቤቱ ሐዋርያት የሰበሰቡዋትን አንዲት
verses.text_am: የምትሆን የቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ሰላም አስብ ከዳርቻ እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ድረስ ያለች
verses.text_en: Remember Lord, the peace of the one holy apostolic Church which reaches from one end of the world to the other.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ጸልዩ በእንተ ሰላመ ቤተ ክርስቲያን አሐቲ ቅድስት ጉባኤ እንተ ሐዋርያት ርትዕት በኀበ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.text_am: ሐዋርያት ለሰበሰቡዋት በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ስለቀናች፣ ክብርት ስለምትሆን አንዲት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ጸልዩ።
verses.text_en: Pray for the peace of the one holy apostolic church orthodox in the Lord.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ኪርያላይሶን ኪርያላይሶን
verses.text_en: Kyrie eleison.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ለጸሎት ለጸሎት ተነሡ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተሣሃለነ አቤቱ ይቅር በለን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ካሀን ሰላም ለኩልክሙ ሰላም ለሁላችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all.
